greet: And dis one na the broom. We dey call am igbale.
greet.ask: Wetin dem dey call the broom?
made: Dem make am from the thin stick wey dey inside palm leaf, dem dry am come tie am together for one end.
made.ask: Wetin dem take make the broom?
olden: Dem don dey tie broom like dis since before anybody wey dey alive now fit remember, from the same palm tree wey dey give us oil and palm wine.
olden.ask: How old dis kind broom be?
festival: Before festival, the whole village go sweep their road and compound, so the elders and the visitors go waka for clean ground.
sweep: Every morning, before sun climb high, we go bend down sweep the house and the compound.
one: One stick alone go break quick quick. When you tie them together, dem strong. Na so family be too.
one.ask: Why dem tie the sticks together?
back: When you don look am finish, put am back where you see am.
